long_biography.plain_text:
Filipiak studied metallurgy and metal physics at AGH University of Science and Technology, then completed postgraduate corporate-finance training and qualified in accounting. After research experience in Adelaide, she started working on her own account in 1990. Three years later, she and Janusz Filipiak established Comarch, developing a Kraków venture into an international supplier of software and systems integration.

From Comarch's earliest years, she served in its governing bodies and became supervisory-board chair. She also leads Grupa EFI, an investment and operating vehicle associated with restaurant and related businesses. As the company returned to private ownership, Filipiak joined her family and CVC in the transaction while retaining a direct preference-share stake. Her career combines founder participation, long-term governance and concentrated ownership in the enterprise technology platform.
